notes.title: Daily Deal! Photo Mode & Contest! | UPDATE 2.0
notes.content: [h2]The End of the Sun featured on the Steam front page - Daily Deal![/h2][p][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We've got some incredible news to share! [b]The End of the Sun[/b] has been featured on the [b]Steam Daily Deal[/b] [b]front page[/b]! [/p][p]This is a huge honor for us, and we're celebrating by offering a fantastic, [b]our biggest so far![/b][/p][p]If you've been waiting to dive into the game's fantasy open world, now's the perfect chance![/p][p][/p][p]But that's not all – we have [b]one more surprise[/b] for you![/p][p][/p][h2]PHOTO MODE - UPDATE 2.0[/h2][p][/p][p]To mark this special occasion, we've just released the highly anticipated [b]Photo Mode[/b] in the game! [/p][p]We know many of you have been asking for this, and we're thrilled to finally bring it to you. [/p][p]Now you can immerse yourself even deeper in the world of The End of the Sun and capture your favorite moments and breathtaking shots like never before. Get ready to unleash your inner in-game photographer![/p][p][/p][p][b]Check out the new Photo Mode Trailer![/b][/p][previewyoutube="quWxsKUBdk0;full"][/previewyoutube][h3]Important![/h3][p]Photo mode takes screenshots [b]automatically to your Steam library.[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]Photo Mode Contest![/h2][p][/p][p]To celebrate the launch of Photo Mode, we're kicking off our very first [b]screenshot contest[/b]! Here's how to participate:[/p][list][*][p][b]Take a stunning screenshot[/b] using the new Photo Mode in The End of the Sun Game.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Share it on Steam Community Hub[/b] (make sure it's public!).[/p][/*][*][p]Get as many likes as possible! [b]IMPORTANT![/b] [b]A minimum of 50 likes is required to participate in the competition! (Finally, only likes on Steam count)[/b][/p][p](To get more likes, [b]share your screenshot on your social media channels[/b], encourage your friends to like your screenshot, and be sure to tag our official game profile when you post.)[/p][p][/p][p][b]Our social media channels:[/b][/p][p]Facebook: [url="https://www.facebook.com/EndOfTheSunGame"]https://www.facebook.com/EndOfTheSunGame[/url][/p][p]Instagram: [url="https://www.instagram.com/endofsungame/"]https://www.instagram.com/endofsungame/[/url][/p][p]X/Twitter: [url="https://x.com/endofthesungame"]https://x.com/endofthesungame[/url][/p][p]Tik Tok: [url="https://www.tiktok.com/@endofsungame"]https://www.tiktok.com/@endofsungame[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]How to share screenshots? Check out![/b][/p][/*][*][p]Choose a screenshot from your Steam Library on The End of the Sun page[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/b2163cf3765fe91cea5b97aeec79ab2447c30bb8.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Press the right mouse button and click "Share," and after "Share on Steam"[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/96f37571a5920bbd83c46944a2e47fb117ded5fe.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Don't forget to share it publicly! (Visibility section)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/db9fbafecadd1d50e8dd4f5db2c5cf7fec0e608b.jpg"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Ready![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]What's in it for you? Awesome prizes, of course![/b][/p][list][*][p][b]1st Place:[/b] A physical [b]Collector's Boxed Edition[/b] of the game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/f565b604a36cc93a5ef6105c3ee5293ea8e7aa9a.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]2nd Place:[/b] C[b]opy of the game[/b] for a friend! (Steam key)[/p][/*][*][p][b]3rd Place:[/b] The official [b]The End of the Sun[/b] [b]Soundtrack[/b]! (Steam key)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special Publisher Choice Award:[/b] The End of the Sun - [b]Soundtrack Edition[/b] (Include game + Soundtrack) (Steam key)[/p][p](An additional prize for the most artistic screenshot! )[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]WHEN?[/h3][p]The contest runs throughout the promotional period, [b]July 20th to August 1st[/b]. Winners will be selected on [b]August 3rd[/b]. The winners and their screenshots will be announced in a separate update. Stay tuned! [/p][p][/p][p][b]We can't wait to see your incredible creations![/b][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/a8fd5c3cac48171e74f9a37817b9addac935b793.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/1a5f3d17584243d81282fae9cd3b3b8ede7cf215.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/e886091c6054bdbb6749ceaf40370e3116ee5ce6.jpg"][/img][/carousel][hr][/hr][h3]Add a REVIEW :) [/h3][p][/p][p]If you like the game, don't forget to [b]write a REVIEW[/b]! [/p][p]Visit the store page and write [b]even a few words[/b], your thoughts, and your feedback mean a lot for our small team! [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/af5136cacc7709dcdd7fd9bdde0f2eefc9f36fdf.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Don't forget to follow the game to get notifications about news :)[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/912840/The_End_of_the_Sun/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/9d099e56e567fa21501a075c8610a9c023f7609b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your support![/p]

notes.title: The End of the Sun : Prologue & Trading Cards Available NOW!
notes.content: [h2]The End of the Sun: Prologue is Available NOW![/h2][p][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p] We're thrilled to announce that [b]The End of the Sun: Prologue[/b] is officially here and completely [b]FREE to play[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/f63295cac2f7995ba5877c5d3ab4ebb68e328a1c.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3]What to Expect in the Prologue[/h3][p][/p][p]The prologue will feature the [b]first mission of the game[/b] and one[b] mission[/b] to showcase the time-travelling mechanics. [/p][p]We created this prologue to give you a taste of the full game and help you decide if The End of the Sun is for you![/p][p][/p][p][b]Step into a world inspired by Slavic myths and legends.[/b][/p][p]As an [b]ashter[/b], a Slavic sorcerer blessed with an incredible gift, you arrive at a mysterious, abandoned village. You find an [b]unusual map[/b] there and begin to explore the area. Initially, you encounter no one, seeing only dimly flickering bonfires. Y[b]our power, however, allows you to connect with the fire[/b], to see visions, and to shape the seemingly ordinary fates of the villagers. Each rekindled bonfire presents a unique challenge steeped in Slavic legends.[/p][p]Dive in and experience the beginning of this unique adventure. We can't wait for you to explore the secrets within![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/1a5f3d17584243d81282fae9cd3b3b8ede7cf215.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/582d2cb48bc11a2fca1a46ebc92bb20686f8a16e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/fcd1eeed336cce4833046b0fb0997242735809b6.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h3][/h3][h2]Wishlist, PLAY, and Write a REVIEW![/h2][p][/p][p]We'd be incredibly grateful if you could [b]add it to your wishlist[/b]! It might seem like just one click, but it significantly boosts our visibility on Steam and helps us out a lot![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3820900/The_End_of_the_Sun_Prologue/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you like the game, don't forget to [b]write a REVIEW on the The End of the Sun: Prologue page[/b]! [/p][p]Visit the prologue store page and write even a few words, your thoughts, and your feedback mean a lot for our small team! :) [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/af5136cacc7709dcdd7fd9bdde0f2eefc9f36fdf.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Community Items - Trading Cards & Points Shop Items[/h2][p]Amazing news! For all you collectors out there, [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] are now available for The End of the Sun! [/p][p]You can also get:[/p][list][*][p]badges[/p][/*][*][p]profile backgrounds[/p][/*][*][p]emoticons[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Start collecting them today![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/d7da2a31d56c8747b3a28c99fd056a6fc2eec0a9.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2]Photo Mode is Coming![/h2][p][/p][p]Great News! We've heard your requests, and we're thrilled to announce that a [b]Photo Mode[/b] will be available in the full version of the game![/p][p]Get ready to capture your favorite in-game moments like never before. [/p][p][/p][p]Photo Mode is coming [b]this Sunday! (July 20th)[/b] Stay tuned![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/d20fec41f1392aedcd0010b647e94c2900ea34a0.jpg"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]TRUE INDIE GAME![/h3][p]As you know, The End of the Sun is a true indie game. Created for over 8 years with passion, mainly by a two-person team.[/p][p]We’d be thrilled if you could spread the word about our game on your social media, gaming forums you frequent, Discord groups, or even your own gaming channels. Whether it's a post, a share, or even just telling a friend, every bit of support means the world to us and helps get the word out about The End of The Sun.[/p][p][/p][h3]I have the full version of the game. Can I help?[/h3][p][/p][p]Yes! [/p][list][*][p]Even if you have already played the full version, please [b]wishlist Prologue and write a review,[/b] it will help us a lot to stay in indie development and make next games. [/p][/*][*][p]Share this news, whatever you want![/p][/*][/list][p]Thank You![/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]We can't wait to hear your thoughts and feedback about the prologue![/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/9d099e56e567fa21501a075c8610a9c023f7609b.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Game update 1.1! NEW Language: Hungarian! Sale -25%
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

[h3][b]We're thrilled to announce that our first game update is now live![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/3a4a3e4c74e98cf4094d9799079a5298c84a48a3.jpg[/img]


This update addresses several minor bugs that you, our fantastic community, reported. Thanks so much for your feedback – it's a huge help!

[h3]NEW LANGUAGE![/h3]

And that's not all! We're excited to share that we've added a brand new language to the game: [b]Hungarian![/b] Welcome to all our new Hungarian-speaking players!

Special thanks to [b]Attila "Ateszkoma" Kurucz[/b], who prepared the entire Hungarian localization for free. 

[h3]Full List of Changes:[/h3]

[b]New Features:[/b]
-Hungarian Language Version of the game!


[b]FIxes:[/b]
-Small fixes in places where the player could get stuck.
-Fixes of graphical glitches where plants or bushes were floating.
-Fixes of some texts in Dalim's workshop.
-A few other minor fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/a82be6445b66ec11242efdc1baca9030c96165b5.jpg[/img]


To celebrate this update, we're offering a fantastic [b]25% discount[/b] on the game for a limited time. Now's a great chance to jump in or tell your friends!

[b]Finally, if you're enjoying the game, we'd be incredibly grateful if you could leave a review.[/b] Even a short sentence helps us out a lot and means the world to us.

Thanks for your continued support! We're excited for what's next!

notes.title: Share your feedback with us!
notes.content:
Dear friends!

The first wave of emotions has settled! We’ve finally made it to the long-awaited release![b] From the bottom of our hearts, thank you for all the warm and positive feedback on the game.[/b] The way you’re experiencing it is a dream come true for us as developers—after nearly eight years of dedication, seeing your reactions makes it all worthwhile.

We’re especially happy that you’re not encountering major bugs—polishing the game was a big priority for us. We also love reading your thoughts on the story! Feel free to reach out here on the Steam forum or via email—we read every message with great joy.

Moreover, we wanted to let you know that [b]Steam Cloud Save, which many of you have requested, is now available![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/882ae724c625aebd8c46db63c66df2c819191d4b.jpg[/img]

But our work isn’t done yet! Some of you have suggested additional settings and small tweaks. We’re open to them, and after a short break—because, you know, we need to catch our breath after these eight years—we’ll be back to work!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33514390/fa0556c5035dc3bfcc68ae955ef1b2fe0258942f.jpg[/img]

[h3]Share your feedback with us! [/h3]

Now, we have one small request:[b] if you’re enjoying the game, please leave a review on Steam.[/b] 

It doesn't have to be long sophisticated text, [b]even a few words are enough[/b] :)  You could do it on our steam store.


[b]So, if you can share The End of The Sun with your friends, post about it, or even let your favorite streamers know about the game—it would help us more than you can imagine.[/b]

Everything we’ve achieved so far has been thanks to your incredible support. Without you, none of this would have been possible. And now, you get to explore the magical world of Slavic myths, uncover its moving story, eat mushrooms, and talk to mice.

Oh, and… has anyone found the radio yet? Haha. Our game is filled with secrets and surprises you probably wouldn’t expect!

Let us know in the comments what you love most about The End of The Sun so far—and keep spreading the word! Thank you!

notes.title: The End of The Sun - Release Date Announced + New Trailer!
notes.content:
Dear Adventurers,

The time has come to unveil the long-awaited [b]release date[/b] for [b]The End of The Sun![/b] Mark your calendars: [b]January 29, 2025.[/b] 
Prepare to step into the mystical world of Slavic mythology, where time travel, secrets, and ancient traditions await!

To celebrate this milestone, we’re thrilled to share a brand-new [b]Official Release Date Trailer![/b] Watch now and get a glimpse of the breathtaking landscapes, immersive storytelling, and the world you’ll explore in the game.

[h3][b] [url=https://youtu.be/Zqf_P-xnYYw]Trailer on Youtube Here - Leave Thumb Up[/url][/b] [/h3]

[previewyoutube=Zqf_P-xnYYw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]What is The End of The Sun?[/b][/h3]

The End of The Sun is a [b]first-person exploration and story-driven adventure game[/b] inspired by [b]Slavic rituals, legends, and culture.[/b] You play as Ashter, a time-traveling sorcerer, tasked with uncovering the mysteries of a village caught between life and death.

[b]Key Features:[/b]

[b]- Time Travel Gameplay:[/b] Explore lives across four seasons and influence the course of events.
Slavic Mythology: Immerse yourself in a rich world of folklore, forgotten traditions, and ancient rituals.
[b]- Photogrammetry Graphics:[/b] Experience unparalleled realism with objects and locations crafted using scans of real-world artifacts.
[b]- Dynamic Environment:[/b] Witness the effects of changing time, weather, and light on your journey.
[b]- Open Exploration and Puzzles:[/b] Solve unique mysteries in a non-linear narrative.

[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]

The countdown to [b]January 29, 2025 [/b]has officially begun! Add the game to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b] and stay updated on all the latest news and announcements.

[b]Wishlist Now:[/b] https://store.steampowered.com/app/912840/The_End_of_the_Sun/ 

Follow us on [url=https://www.facebook.com/EndOfTheSunGame][b]Facebook[/b][/url] for exclusive behind-the-scenes content and updates!

Thank you for your support and enthusiasm as we approach this incredible journey together. Let the adventure begin!
